usageNote: 名词短语！说人生高光时刻用这个，比special moment强烈100倍，充满仪式感！

examples.en: Winning the championship was the greatest moment of my life.
examples.zh: 赢得冠军是我人生中最伟大的时刻。

examples.en: She said holding her baby for the first time was the greatest moment she had ever experienced.
examples.zh: 她说第一次抱着宝宝是她经历过的最美好的时刻。
